6|Mini Check.rule_explanation_en: 1. "My gums are becoming quite uncomfortable." — Which tense, and why? 2. "I'm trying to brush regularly." — Which tense and what is the formula? 3. "It might be one of the reasons." — What does might express? 4. "You should continue flossing carefully." — What are should and flossing doing here? 5. "If I follow all these recommendations, will my gums return to normal?" — Which Conditional is this? 6. "The teeth aren't being cleaned thoroughly." — Which Passive form is this? 7. "to remove the plaque and tartar" — What does to + V1 express here? Rule for this module: tenses from earlier modules are only briefly reviewed; the focus is on the Present Continuous, be going to, modal verbs, First Conditional, Passive Voice, gerund and infinitive constructions actually used in the Gum Problems dialogue.
6|Mini Check.rule_explanation_ru: 1. «My gums are becoming quite uncomfortable.» — Какое время и почему? 2. «I'm trying to brush regularly.» — Какое время и какова формула? 3. «It might be one of the reasons.» — Что выражает might? 4. «You should continue flossing carefully.» — Какую функцию выполняют should и flossing? 5. «If I follow all these recommendations, will my gums return to normal?» — Какой это Conditional? 6. «The teeth aren't being cleaned thoroughly.» — Какая это форма Passive? 7. «to remove the plaque and tartar» — Что здесь выражает to + V1? Правило модуля: времена из предыдущих модулей только кратко повторяются; основное внимание — Present Continuous, be going to, модальные глаголы, First Conditional, Passive Voice, герундий и инфинитив, реально использованные в диалоге Gum Problems.

7|Review: tenses from previous modules.rule_explanation_en: Review — Present Simple: a fact, a habitual state or a clinical description. Present Perfect: a past action connected to a present result or experience. Past Simple: an action or decision completed in the past. Future (will): a future action or decision.
7|Review: tenses from previous modules.rule_explanation_ru: Повторение — Present Simple: факт, привычное состояние или клиническое описание. Present Perfect: прошедшее действие, связанное с настоящим результатом или опытом. Past Simple: действие или решение, завершённое в прошлом. Future (will): будущее действие или решение.
